snow-roads-scenic-route.title: Snow Roads Scenic Route
snow-roads-scenic-route.slogan: Blairgowrie to Grantown on Spey · one way, about 205 km back to the start

waypoints.name: Blairgowrie

waypoints.advice: 103 km in you reach Lecht Pass. Nothing on this route is higher. Next is Tomintoul, mostly downhill.

sections.advice: Blairgowrie → Braemar is 58 km of rhythm rather than effort. Let it flow and let the view breathe.
Braemar → Lecht Pass climbs about 637 m in 30 km. This is the part worth slowing down for - look through the bends and use the pull-offs.
Lecht Pass → Tomintoul drops about 637 m over 12 km. Brakes and eyes forward; the views are behind the corners, not in them.
Tomintoul → Grantown on Spey is 21 km of rhythm rather than effort. Let it flow and let the view breathe.

snow-roads-scenic-route.provenance: CURATED FROM THE ARCHIVE: waypoints taken from the named road Snow Roads Scenic Route. Distances between stops are great-circle with a road factor, not a routed measurement - the pipeline replaces them when it routes this line.

scenicChapters.title: Snow Roads Scenic Route
scenicChapters.narrative: The ground tilts up and stays tilted for 51 km. 637 m of it, taken steadily rather than in one wall. A steady rhythm suits this better than bursts. The height arrives whether you hurry or not.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.

scenicChapters.title: Snow Roads Scenic Route
scenicChapters.narrative: Brakes early, eyes far ahead. A descent this long asks more of concentration than of pace. 637 m come off over 20 km at around 5.4%. The road gives back what the climb took, faster than it took it.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.

scenicChapters.title: Snow Roads Scenic Route
scenicChapters.narrative: For 35 km this is Snow Roads Scenic Route, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it — expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast.

snow-roads-scenic-route.story: A one-way ride of 205 km, Blairgowrie to Grantown on Spey - roughly 2 h 47 in the saddle. It goes by way of Braemar, Lecht Pass and Tomintoul. A steady touring day rather than a sprint.

scenicChapters.title: Saint Petersburg Imperial Shore
scenicChapters.narrative: Water arrives beside the road and stays for 25 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go — slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did.

scenicChapters.title: Saint Petersburg Imperial Shore
scenicChapters.narrative: For 26 km this is Saint Petersburg Imperial Shore, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it. Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast.
